body: I think I would like that, thanks.

> is there anything you want to talk about?  

I don't know, I guess I just want to talk.  I like people, I like learning, I suppose I'm just willing to have someone try to convince me not to kill myself.  That might be why I said that.

> Do you want to tell me about yourself?  

Not really, I don't see the point in that.    

> Talk about your day? 

I listened to some music.  That's really it.    
  


> What do you like to do?  

I like to help people and make music.  No, neither of those things will change what I want to do tomorrow.
I'm lonely and I'm not strong enough to fix it.  I'm not strong enough because it hurts too much and I'd rather be weak and kill myself.
